notes: Total edges proposed: 28 (27 primary + 1 dual-membership second edge for information-retrieval).
Nodes covered: all 27 CS-continent skeleton nodes (22 reviewed + 5 proposed). subfield:machine-learning excluded as instructed — reviewed edge already exists.

Depth-nesting decisions: algorithms-and-data-structures, computational-complexity-theory, and formal-languages-and-automata-theory are proposed with subfield:theoretical-computer-science as parent (not field:computer-science directly), following the §12 2026-06-10 edge-depth precedent and the ASL-pillar-under-mathematical-logic mirror case explicitly cited in the batch instructions. CCS and MSC 68Q both nest them under the Theory of computation / 68Q block.

CV and NLP proposed with field:computer-science as parent (not nested under artificial-intelligence): CCS files all three (AI, CV, NLP) as siblings under Computing methodologies; UDC 004.93 (CV) and 004.912 (NLP) are siblings of 004.8 (AI). The prompt explicitly asked to weigh and flag this — both sources agree on sibling status, so ambiguous:false is correct.

§13 dual-membership: information-retrieval receives TWO edges: one to field:computer-science (ACM CCS + MSC 68P20) and one to field:library-and-information-science (LCC Z699-699.5 + UDC 025.4). Both are proposed as co-equal per §13.

Status caps: scientific-computing and quantum-computing stop at 'proposed' (B-type flags retained by QC, per qc-report). computer-systems, distributed-and-parallel-computing, and databases-and-information-systems stop at 'proposed' (QID-less v1.2 grounding). Batch manifest note: edge status capped at min(endpoint statuses) — these 5 proposed-endpoint nodes cap their edges at 'proposed'.
